name: Animalica - Compatibility Pack 1
description: other mods had animals. i wanted to be those animals. the keyboard was unattended. playable-model integration for supported optional animal mods, including three Wolf Taming dogs. install the providers you want; their matching models appear when available. this version does not include playable Equus models.
